$comment: Custom entity models (OptiFine CEM .jem files that Entity Model Features applies) per entity, from the pack stack in texture-manifest.json. Generated by tools/make-cem-manifest.mjs (npm run cem).

$fields.source: id (and sourceIndex into texture-manifest.json sources) of the highest-priority pack that has the model
$fields.properties: the .properties file beside it (which entities/textures it applies to, if any)
$fields.parts: vanilla part names the model entries replace
$fields.geometryInJpm: boxes live in .jpm part files rather than the .jem
$fields.jpm: part files it names, with box and animation counts
$fields.animations: whether expression animations exist (they are not evaluated by the wiki)
$fields.shadowed: lower-priority packs with the same model
$fields.variants: other models of the same entity (numbered skins, _baby, _saddle, …)
$fields.mob: the wiki entity id (game-data/mobs.json) this model belongs to, when there is one
